scope: Conditional calendar exposure, straight-wall stress, corrosion sensitivity and pressure-only fatigue interpolation; not manufacturing, road feasibility or validated material service life

checks.name: Exactly 730 daily exposures cover 36500 prescribed kilometres
Driving and warm-up hours remain separate
One daily cold start gives 730 thermal/pressure start cycles
RPM is converted through 60 minutes/hour, not treated as seconds
Each piston completes two strokes, one full cycle per local crank revolution
Local gearing produces two local cycles per common output revolution
Slower prescribed travel doubles operating cycle count, not the kilometres
Seasonal temperature uses the requested exact analytical endpoints
The sampled synthetic season has 328 sub-zero exposures
Constant cold/hot extremes distinguish 730 and zero frost exposures
Draining/trace heating removes unprotected-water flag only under explicit assumptions
Heater energy is charged for actual standing hours and UA
Doubling heat leakage doubles heater energy and leaves corrosion unchanged
Uniform external corrosion reduces 4 mm wall to 3.8 mm in two years
Lamé stress independently matches pressure and remaining radii
Corrosion increases stress at fixed pressure; zero loss retains initial dimensions
A vanishing wall is reported rather than a finite or negative pressure stress
Wall thickness and finite pressure stress change monotonically over exposure
Free thermal expansion depends on length and does not cause stress at zero restraint
Cold-start elastic restraint estimate gives 66 MPa, not 66 GPa
Unknown coil length stays unknown instead of inventing zero expansion
No cooling below ambient is silently assigned to uncooled low-temperature lines
Missing material data never become zero fatigue/creep or certified life
Prescribed mileage is not represented as validated road or freezing simulation
Logarithmic S–N interpolation is independently checked at geometric midpoint
S–N extrapolation is not performed
Miner pressure-start damage uses 730 pressure starts, never 113 million engine turns
Supplying a pressure curve does not certify thermal or total service life
Incorrect R, missing source, missing points and temperature mismatch are rejected
Invalid inputs and impossible daily time budgets are rejected
Published default run is exactly reproduced from its inputs
Published nine scenario summaries reproduce from the same model
Initial exposure keeps mileage, 730 starts and 113 million cycles distinct
Seasonal unprotected-water issue is visible rather than a successful winter run
All modeled pipes and the generator coil appear in the table
Formulas come before substitutions and their rounded results
Nine winter/climate combinations are shown
Slower prescribed speed doubles exposure hours and cycles
Repeated daily starts double startup count without inventing more road cycles
Cold endpoint exposes every unprotected standing period
Heated storage displays +5 C metal and charges energy
Drainage hypothesis changes freezing flag without a claim of qualified lifetime
Day slider changes the wall section and daily readout
Playback advances physical calendar days and can be paused
Pause stops the calendar
Zero corrosion restores geometric wall and original nominal stress
Vanishing wall does not produce a fictitious finite stress
Unknown coil length remains unknown in the display
S-N import enables only conditional pressure damage, not total life
Clearing calibration restores unknown damage
An incompatible fatigue curve is rejected
Invalid input clears stale results and disables export
Export retains the full 730-day history, physical dimensions and limitations
The page fits a narrow screen without document overflow
Default study and all nine scenarios are accessible without JavaScript
No uncaught browser errors
